# FlexibleAdapter source dependency

Source: https://github.com/arkon/FlexibleAdapter
Pinned commit: c80135339bcff5f7f8c2c2380329dfc155b26232
License: Apache-2.0 (LICENSE).

Zink previously downloaded this exact version from JitPack. The artifact is now missing because upstream publishing fails on java-ordered-properties:1.0.1. Java and resource files are unchanged. Only the manifest package declaration is replaced by the modern Gradle namespace, and the build script uses Zink conventions and AndroidX dependencies.
